# DE Analysis

```{r Setup}
#| results: hide

library(GeomxTools)
library(dplyr)
library(limma)
library(edgeR)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(stringr)
library(PCAtools)
library(readxl)
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)
library(DSPWorkflow)
library(standR)
library(SpatialExperiment)
library(ggVennDiagram)
library(patchwork)
library(openxlsx)

# Source the helper functions
source("DSP_functions.R")

parameters <- yaml::read_yaml(params$config.path)

# Combine the common and comparison specific DE parameters
de.comparisons <- lapply(parameters$de$comparisons, function(comparison) {
  modifyList(parameters$de$common, comparison)
})
names(de.comparisons) <- vapply(
  de.comparisons,
  function(comparison) comparison$contrast.name,
  character(1)
)

# Check for output folders and create the folder if missing
output.folders <- c(parameters$paths$de.folder, 
                    paste0(parameters$paths$de.folder, "volcano/"), 
                    parameters$paths$gsea.folder, 
                    paste0(parameters$paths$de.folder, "backup_results/"), 
                    paste0(parameters$paths$de.folder, "method_comparison/"))

for(folder in output.folders){
  
  if(!dir.exists(folder)){
    
    print(paste0(folder, " not found. Creating the folder now."))
    dir.create(folder, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    
  }
}
```

### Load the all Input Counts and Annotation

```{r Load Normalized Counts}

normalized.object <- readRDS(file = paste0(parameters$paths$qc.folder, 
                                           parameters$paths$dataset.name, 
                                           "_q3normalized_object.RDS"))

# Load the StandR RUV object
standr.ruv.object <- readRDS(file = paste0(parameters$paths$qc.folder, 
                                           "StandR/standr_ruv_object.RDS"))



```

## Run DE Comparisons

```{r Run DE Comparisons}
#| results: hide
#| fig-show: hide

de.outputs <- run_all_de_comparisons(
  de.comparisons = de.comparisons,
  normalized.object = normalized.object,
  parameters = parameters,
  standr.object = standr.ruv.object
)
```

## Differential Expression Results

```{r Display DE Results}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

# Emit HTML outputs with their required knitr dependencies.
emit_knitr_output <- function(output) {
  if (isTRUE(getOption("knitr.in.progress"))) {
    rendered <- knitr::knit_print(
      output,
      options = knitr::opts_current$get()
    )

    knitr::knit_meta_add(attr(rendered, "knit_meta"))

    cat("\n\n", rendered, "\n\n", sep = "")
  } else {
    print(output)
  }

  invisible(NULL)
}



for (comparison in names(de.outputs)) {
  comparison.title <- str_to_title(gsub("_", " ", comparison))
  comparison.parameters <- de.comparisons[[comparison]]
  fc.limit <- default_if_null(comparison.parameters$fc.limit, 1.5)
  padj.limit <- default_if_null(comparison.parameters$padj.limit, 0.05)

  cat(
    "\n### ",
    comparison.title,
    "\n\n::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n#### Volcano\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  cat(
    "Genes are classified using adjusted p-value < ",
    padj.limit,
    " and |log2FC| > ",
    fc.limit,
    ".\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  for (de.method in comparison.parameters$de.method) {
    method.output <- de.outputs[[comparison]][[de.method]]
    if (is.null(method.output$results) || is.null(method.output$volcano)) {
      next
    }

    cat("##### ", str_to_title(de.method), "\n\n", sep = "")
    interactive.plot <- plotly::ggplotly(
      make_de_volcano_interactive(
        results.df = method.output$results,
        comp.parameters = comparison.parameters
      ),
      tooltip = "text"
    )
    interactive.plot <- plotly::layout(
      interactive.plot,
      legend = list(
        x = 1.02,
        y = 1,
        xanchor = "left",
        yanchor = "top",
        font = list(size = 9)
      ),
      margin = list(r = 120)
    )
    emit_knitr_output(interactive.plot)
  }

  cat("\n#### Differentially Expressed Genes\n\n")
  for (de.method in comparison.parameters$de.method) {
    method.results <- de.outputs[[comparison]][[de.method]]$results
    if (is.null(method.results)) {
      next
    }

    degs <- select_degs_for_report(
      results.df = method.results,
      fc.limit = fc.limit,
      padj.limit = padj.limit
    )
    cat("##### ", str_to_title(de.method), "\n\n", sep = "")
    if (nrow(degs) == 0) {
      cat("No genes meet the configured adjusted p-value and logFC cutoffs.\n\n")
    } else {
      deg.table <- degs %>%
        dplyr::select(gene, logfc, padj) %>%
        gt::gt() %>%
        gt::cols_label(
          gene = "Gene",
          logfc = "Log2 fold change",
          padj = "Adjusted p-value"
        ) %>%
        gt::fmt_number(columns = logfc, decimals = 4) %>%
        gt::fmt_scientific(columns = padj, decimals = 2) %>%
        gt::opt_interactive(
          use_pagination = TRUE,
          use_pagination_info = TRUE,
          use_sorting = TRUE,
          use_search = TRUE,
          use_compact_mode = TRUE,
          use_page_size_select = TRUE,
          page_size_default = 10,
          page_size_values = c(10, 25, 50, 100),
          height = 400
        )

      emit_knitr_output(deg.table)
    }
  }
  cat("\n:::\n\n")
}

```

## Venn Diagram to Compare Method DEGs

### Venn Function

```{r Venn Diagram Function}

# Venn Diagram function

method_degs_venn <- function(de.results, 
                             title, 
                             logfc.cutoff){ 
  
  # Gather the up and down degs for each result
  up.standr <- de.results$standr$results %>% 
    filter(padj < 0.05, logfc >= logfc.cutoff)
  up.standr.degs <- up.standr$gene
  
  down.standr <- de.results$standr$results %>% 
    filter(padj < 0.05, logfc <= -logfc.cutoff)
  down.standr.degs <- down.standr$gene
  
  up.default <- de.results$default$results %>% 
    filter(padj < 0.05, logfc >= logfc.cutoff)
  up.default.degs <- up.default$gene
  
  down.default <- de.results$default$results %>% 
    filter(padj < 0.05, logfc <= -logfc.cutoff)
  down.default.degs <- down.default$gene
  
  
  up.venn <- ggVennDiagram(list("StandR" = up.standr.degs, 
                                "Default" = up.default.degs), 
                           label = "count", 
                           set_size = 0) + 
    scale_fill_gradient(low="grey90",high = "red") + 
    ggtitle(paste0("Upregulated DEGs, logFC > ", logfc.cutoff)) + 
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 7.0,
      label = "Default",
      size = 5,
      fontface = "bold") +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = -3.0,
      label = "StandR",
      size = 5,
      fontface = "bold")
  
  down.venn <- ggVennDiagram(list("StandR" = down.standr.degs, 
                                "Default" = down.default.degs), 
                             label = "count", 
                             set_size = 0) + 
    scale_fill_gradient(low="grey90",high = "blue") + 
    ggtitle(paste0("Downregulated DEGs, logFC < -", logfc.cutoff)) + 
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 7.0,
      label = "Default",
      size = 5,
      fontface = "bold") +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = -3.0,
      label = "StandR",
      size = 5,
      fontface = "bold")
  
  all.venn <- up.venn + down.venn + 
    plot_layout(ncol = 2) + 
    plot_annotation(title = title, 
                    theme = theme(
                      plot.title = element_text(
                      size = 16,
                      face = "bold",
                      hjust = 0.5)
                      )
    )
  
  
  # Get the overlapping DEGs list
  up.shared <- intersect(up.standr.degs, up.default.degs) 
  up.standr.unique <- setdiff(up.standr.degs, up.default.degs)
  up.default.unique <- setdiff(up.default.degs, up.standr.degs)
  down.shared <- intersect(down.standr.degs, down.default.degs)
  down.standr.unique <- setdiff(down.standr.degs, down.default.degs)
  down.default.unique <- setdiff(down.default.degs, down.standr.degs)
  
  venn.degs.df <- data.frame(
    group = c(rep("up_shared", length(up.shared)),
              rep("up_standr", length(up.standr.unique)),
              rep("up_default", length(up.default.unique)), 
              rep("down_shared", length(down.shared)),
              rep("down_standr", length(down.standr.unique)),
              rep("down_default", length(down.default.unique))
              ),
  gene = c(
    up.shared, 
    up.standr.unique, 
    up.default.unique, 
    down.shared, 
    down.standr.unique, 
    down.default.unique
    )
)
  
  
  
  return(list("up.venn" = up.venn, 
              "down.venn" = down.venn, 
              "all.venn" = all.venn, 
              "venn.degs.df" = venn.degs.df))
  
}


```

### Create Venn Diagrams

```{r Create Venn Diagrams}

comparison.venn.list <- list()

for(comparison in names(de.outputs)){
  
  comparison.de.results <- de.outputs[[comparison]]
  
  comparison.title <- str_to_title(gsub("_", " ", comparison))
  comparison.venn.diagrams <- method_degs_venn(de.results = comparison.de.results, 
                                               title = comparison.title, 
                                               logfc.cutoff = 1)
  
  comparison.venn.list[[comparison]] <- comparison.venn.diagrams
  
  if(parameters$de$common$export.venn){
    
    ggsave(comparison.venn.diagrams$all.venn, 
           file = paste0(parameters$paths$de.folder, 
                         "method_comparison/", 
                         comparison, 
                         "_de_venn.png"))
    
  }
  
  
}


# Create an excel output file with one tab per contrast
if(parameters$de$common$write.deg.lists){
  
  deg.list.output <- createWorkbook()
  
  for(comparison in names(comparison.venn.list)){
    
    deg.list <- comparison.venn.list[[comparison]]$venn.degs.df
    
    addWorksheet(deg.list.output, comparison)
    writeData(deg.list.output, 
              sheet = comparison, 
              deg.list)
    
    saveWorkbook(deg.list.output, 
                 paste0(parameters$paths$de.folder, 
                        "method_comparison/", 
                        "deg_list_method_comparison.xlsx"), 
                 overwrite = TRUE)
  }
  
}
  

```

#| echo: false
#| results: asis

for (comparison in names(comparison.venn.list)) {
  comparison.title <- str_to_title(gsub("_", " ", comparison))
  diagrams <- comparison.venn.list[[comparison]]

  cat(
    "\n### ",
    comparison.title,
    "\n\n::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n#### Upregulated\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  print(diagrams$up.venn)
  cat("\n\n#### Downregulated\n\n")
  print(diagrams$down.venn)
  cat("\n:::\n\n")
}
